svg.title: Three steps to causal attention weights
svg.desc: Scaled scores pass through softmax, element-wise multiplication by a lower triangular mask, and division by each retained row sum. The diagonal is retained.

g.text: Causal masking: normalize, hide the future, normalize again
Each query row sums to ≈ 1, but still includes future positions.
weights * tril(ones) · future entries become zero · diagonal stays
3. Divide by row sums → causal weights [6, 6]
Each query row sums to ≈ 1 again; future contributions stay zero.
Masking uses * (cell by cell). Comparing queries and keys uses @ (matrix multiplication).
